title: Strawberry Cream Salad
description: This strawberry cream salad recipe is crunchy, sweet, and salty, with a cracker-flecked meringue layer, a cheese layer, and satiny strawberry topping.
ingredients: 1 (16 ounce) container frozen whipped topping, thawed
1 (6 ounce) package strawberry flavored Jell-O® mix

steps.text: Preheat the oven to 350 degrees F (175 degrees C).

Beat egg whites in a glass, metal, or ceramic bowl with an electric mixer until foamy. Beat in 2 cups sugar and cream of tartar on medium speed until stiff peaks form. Fold in cracker pieces, walnuts, and vanilla; spread into the bottom of a 9x13-inch pan.
Bake in the preheated oven for 25 minutes. Cool.
Mix cream cheese and remaining ½ cup sugar in a medium bowl; fold in whipped topping. Spread cream cheese mixture onto cooled crust.

Whisk boiling water and gelatin together in a medium bowl until gelatin dissolved; mix in frozen strawberries. Set aside for 15 minutes; pour strawberry mixture over cream cheese layer, cover, and chill until ready to serve.
